label: Bible Study
prompt: Take therefore no thought for the _____: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verse: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
note: 'Morrow' is KJV for tomorrow — and tomorrow, Jesus says, can do its own worrying.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wait on the LORD: be of good _____, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
verse: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
note: Wait, take courage, wait again — David bookends the advice, because waiting is the hard part.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the king said, _____ the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verse: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
note: Solomon's famous ruling: threaten to split the baby, and the real mother reveals herself.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their _____ parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verse: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
note: The new covenant: God's law moves from stone tablets to hearts — Hebrews 8 quotes the whole passage.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not _____ for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verse: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
note: The passage that converted Augustine in a Milan garden in 386, after a voice said 'take up and read.'
